title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.4.0 adds three new kernel-verified modules (7,286 new lines) and two standalone audit ledgers: (1) a growth-free finite-contour simple-pole transfer engine over convergent meromorphic germs C({t}) (scalar finite-pole count bound, strong C({t}) D-transcendence, joint multi-series differential independence, and universal entire logarithmic-derivative bridge -E'/E with zero growth assumption at infinity, zero global wedge, and zero collinearity); (2) 100% unconditional theorems over Mathlib plus this repository's proved modules, with no extra hypotheses (zero RH, zero external data structures, zero numerical tables) for the completed Riemann xi function: infinitude of nontrivial zeros without Stirling or Hadamard factorization, strong C({t}) D-transcendence in t = 1/u for the factorial-moment / formal-Laplace series of -xi'(c+w)/xi(c+w) at every real center c (including c = 1/2; not for zeta(s) in s), joint multi-center differential independence for any finite injective family of real centers, and real-axis Laplace integral B_xi c u ADE obstruction over C{1/u}; and (3) a unified spectral-positivity and strict Hankel positive-definiteness framework comprising an unconditional abstract core plus explicitly parameterized zero-RH/GRH arithmetic specializations (SpectralLowZeroData with finite low-zero list gamma_low : List R, permitting arbitrary off-line zeros |Im gamma| < 1/2) for the (15,20,1), (7,16,10), and (10,16,10) regimes alongside parameterized subtracted compact hyperbolic spectral measures in dimensions d = 2, 3 (SubtractedHyperbolicSpectralData); these data structures are not connected in Lean to the zeros of completedXi, L(s, chi_{-4}), L(s, Delta), or a concrete hyperbolic manifold's Laplace eigenvalues (zero enumeration, low-height verification, Hadamard/Weyl bounds, and Taylor-coefficient matching remain external). All 207 audited declarations depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
